title: OpenAI product writing assistant
summary: Generate and review French product names, descriptions and tags from your own product facts.

changes.detail: Expandable writing assistant with facts input, three tones, generated preview and separate apply buttons. Existing form facts are included; new product slugs update when applying a name. Editing an existing product preserves its URL.

Admin-authorized same-origin rate-limited endpoint using existing server-only OpenAI Responses integration. Input/output validation, bounded request sizes, timeout and safe configuration/billing errors. No automatic database writes; API key never reaches browser.
General information form now includes AI writing before the description field. Prompt restricts output to supplied facts and rejects internal inventory tags.

validation.name: Pending checks
validation.detail: Local server key is configured (presence only checked). Automated route tests, lint and typecheck pending. Browser and live model output not yet tested. No deployment.
